```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list = ls())

# Load libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Read file
metabolic_xlsx <- paste0(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/metabolic_output/",
  "65genus/METABOLIC_result.xlsx"
)

# Read the FunctionHit sheet
metabolic_genes <- read_excel(
  metabolic_xlsx,
  sheet = "FunctionHit"
)

# Extract only complex carbon degradation rows
complex_carbon <- metabolic_genes %>%
  filter(Category == "Complex carbon degradation")

```



Long format and cleaning
```{r}
# Convert the 65 MAG columns to long format
complex_carbon_long <- complex_carbon %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Category, Function, Gene.abbreviation),
    names_to = "MAG_raw",
    values_to = "Presence"
  )

# Clean MAG names so they match the CoverM/Fig. 5E identifiers
complex_carbon_long <- complex_carbon_long %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = MAG_raw %>%
      str_remove("^X") %>%
      str_remove("^extracted_") %>%
      str_remove("\\.Function\\.presence$")
  )

# Convert Present/Absent to binary values
complex_carbon_long <- complex_carbon_long %>%
  mutate(
    Presence = case_when(
      Presence == "Present" ~ 1,
      Presence == "Absent"  ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

```



Some helpful calculations
```{r}
# How widely distributed is each carbon degradation gene?
gene_prevalence <- complex_carbon_long %>%
  group_by(
    Function,
    Gene.abbreviation
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    MAGs_present = sum(Presence, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent_MAGs = MAGs_present / 48 * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(MAGs_present))


# How broad is the carbon degradation repertoire of each MAG?
mag_carbon_breadth <- complex_carbon_long %>%
  group_by(MAG) %>%
  summarise(
    Functions_detected = sum(Presence, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent_functions = Functions_detected / 17 * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Functions_detected))
```



Bring in relative abundance from coverm and find avg for each genus
```{r}
# Read in files
folder <- "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/coverm_65"

files <- list.files(
  path = folder,
  pattern = "\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  
  dat <- read.delim(
    f,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Keep only Genome + the 3 measurements
  dat <- dat[, 1:4]
  
  # Give the columns consistent names
  colnames(dat) <- c(
    "Genome",
    "Mean",
    "Relative_Abundance",
    "Covered_Fraction"
  )
  
  dat
})

names(data_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files))

# Combine all
all_data <- bind_rows(data_list, .id = "Culture")

# Remove "coverm_" from the Culture names 
all_data <- all_data %>% mutate( Culture = sub("^coverm_", "", Culture) )


# Remove CoverM "unmapped" rows
all_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("unmapped", Genome, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )


# Calculate median relative abundance for each genome
median_abundance <- all_data %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Relative_Abundance = median(
      Relative_Abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Median_Relative_Abundance)
  )

```



We want to order the genus by phylum
```{r}
# Get phylum from GTDB
gtdb <- read.delim(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/metabolic_output/65genus/gtdbtk_Genome_files/classify/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Extract taxonomy from GTDB classification
taxonomy <- gtdb %>%
  select(user_genome, classification) %>%
  separate(
    classification,
    into = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "class",
      "order",
      "family",
      "genus",
      "species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain  = str_remove(domain,  "^d__"),
    phylum  = str_remove(phylum,  "^p__"),
    class   = str_remove(class,   "^c__"),
    order   = str_remove(order,   "^o__"),
    family  = str_remove(family,  "^f__"),
    genus   = str_remove(genus,   "^g__"),
    species = str_remove(species, "^s__")
  )

# Create one genus-to-phylum lookup
genus_phylum_lookup <- taxonomy %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(genus),
    genus != "",
    !is.na(phylum),
    phylum != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    genus,
    phylum
  )

genus_phylum_lookup <- genus_phylum_lookup %>%
  filter(
    genus != "f_CAISDR01"
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      genus = "f_CAISDR01",
      phylum = "Pseudomonadota"
    )
  )

# Create MAG-level taxonomy table for the carbon degradation figure
mag_taxonomy <- taxonomy %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = user_genome) %>%
  select(
    MAG,
    genus,
    phylum
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genus = recode(
      genus,
      "NK_genus" = "f_CAISDR01"
    ),
    
    # Keep the same manual phylum assignment used in Fig. 5E
    phylum = if_else(
      genus == "f_CAISDR01",
      "Pseudomonadota",
      phylum
    )
  )
```



Create annotation table
```{r}
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Actinomycetota"  = "#7c6f64",
  "Bacteroidota"    = "#5b7694",
  "Cyanobacteriota" = "#52796f",
  "Pseudomonadota"  = "#b45f5a",
    "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56"
)

phylum_order <- names(phylum_colors)


mag_annotation <- complex_carbon_long %>%
  distinct(MAG) %>%
  
  # Add genus and phylum
  left_join(
    mag_taxonomy,
    by = "MAG"
  ) %>%
  
  # Add CoverM median relative abundance
  left_join(
    median_abundance,
    by = c("MAG" = "Genome")
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    phylum = factor(
      phylum,
      levels = phylum_order
    )
  )

# Ordering
mag_order <- mag_annotation %>%
  arrange(
    phylum,
    desc(Median_Relative_Abundance),
    genus,
    MAG
  ) %>%
  pull(MAG)


mag_annotation <- mag_annotation %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = factor(
      MAG,
      levels = rev(mag_order)
    )
  )


complex_carbon_long <- complex_carbon_long %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = factor(
      MAG,
      levels = rev(mag_order)
    )
  )
```



Plot
```{r}
# Define phylum colors
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Actinomycetota"  = "#7c6f64",
  "Bacteroidota"    = "#5b7694",
  "Cyanobacteriota" = "#52796f",
  "Pseudomonadota"  = "#b45f5a",
    "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56"
)


# Preserve METABOLIC's original order of carbon degradation
# functions rather than sorting alphabetically
gene_order <- complex_carbon %>%
  pull(Gene.abbreviation) %>%
  unique()

complex_carbon_long <- complex_carbon_long %>%
  mutate(
    Gene.abbreviation = factor(
      Gene.abbreviation,
      levels = gene_order
    ),
    MAG = factor(
      MAG,
      levels = rev(mag_order)
    )
  )


# Genus/phylum annotation panel
phylum_plot <- ggplot(
  mag_annotation,
  aes(
    x = 1,
    y = MAG,
    fill = phylum
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = genus
    ),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = phylum_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "Phylum"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 0,
      b = 0,
      l = 0
    )
  )


# MAG ID column
mag_id_plot <- ggplot(
  mag_annotation,
  aes(
    x = 1,
    y = MAG
  )
) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = MAG
    ),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 1.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 2,
      b = 0,
      l = 2
    )
  )


# Median CoverM relative abundance column
abundance_plot <- ggplot(
  mag_annotation,
  aes(
    x = 1,
    y = MAG
  )
) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf(
        "%.2f",
        Median_Relative_Abundance
      )
    ),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 1.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 2,
      b = 0,
      l = 2
    )
  )


# Complex-carbon degradation presence/absence matrix
carbon_plot <- ggplot(
  complex_carbon_long,
  aes(
    x = Gene.abbreviation,
    y = MAG
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = factor(Presence)),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  
  # Separate the six functional categories
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(3.5, 6.5, 8.5, 11.5, 15.5),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0" = "white",
      "1" = "#d6a85f"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "0" = "Absent",
      "1" = "Present"
    ),
    name = "Complex carbon\ndegradation function"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 0,
      b = 0,
      l = 0
    )
  )


# Combine panels
carbon_combined_plot <-
  phylum_plot +
  mag_id_plot +
  abundance_plot +
  carbon_plot +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(
      2.0,
      2.4,
      0.8,
      12
    ),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


carbon_combined_plot
```
